lines.t: I’ve been running through the quiet of my doubts,
Trying to hold myself together somehow.
But in the stillness, You whisper my name—
A gentle calling, pulling me from shame.
Your mercy falls like soft rain on my chest,
You take my worry and You give me rest.
Even in shadows, I’m never alone—
Your love keeps leading my heart home.
And every fear starts fading in Your truth,
Every breath reminds me I belong to You.
YahuShua,
When Your light rests on me,
Every burden grows light, every sorrow finds peace.
You heal what I hide, You steady my soul—
You’re the One who makes the broken whole.
YahuShua,
When Your love covers me,
I find the strength to stand on my knees.
In the warmth of Your mercy, I finally see—
This is where I’m meant to be.
You know the battles that I never speak,
The nights I’m strong, the days I’m weak.
Yet still You stay, unchanging, kind—
A faithful anchor in my wandering mind.
You take the ashes of who I’ve been,
And breathe Your promise into me again.
No greater hope, no deeper grace,
Than feeling Your presence fill this place.
And every doubt is softened by Your voice,
Teaching my trembling heart to rejoice.
YahuShua,
When Your light rests on me,
Every burden grows light, every sorrow finds peace.
You heal what I hide, You steady my soul—
You’re the One who makes the broken whole.
YahuShua,
When Your love covers me,
I find the strength to stand on my knees.
In the warmth of Your mercy, I finally see—
This is where I’m meant to be.
Here in the quiet, You’re speaking still…
Calling my heart to trust Your will.
Your peace like rivers, soft and deep,
And in Your arms, my soul can sleep.
You lift the weight I cannot bear,
You breathe Your life into the air…
YahuShua,
When Your light rests on me,
Every burden grows light, every sorrow finds peace.
You heal what I hide, You steady my soul—
You’re the One who makes the broken whole.
YahuShua,
Your love carries me,
Through every valley, through every need.
In the warmth of Your mercy, I finally see—
This is where I’m meant to be…
Always with You…
My King.
